title: 第十六章 魔帅截青嶂 再启山河杀劫第十七章 灵渊凝玉魄 魔影蓄深谋
content_zh:
古林时序重归，千山浊气尽散。
年月日四神取回首枚时序玉璧残片，天道补全一线，三界气机为之清宁，地脉紊乱渐得平复，苍生气运微微复苏。林间风露澄澈，草木重荣，四时循轨，昼夜分明，皆是玉璧归位、正道昌明之兆。
四人立身林巅，远眺万里河山，眼底苍生疾苦未尽，浩劫余痕犹存。何年收束时序清光，眸色沉凝，心怀万里沧桑，缓缓言道：“首璧归位，天道得补，此乃三界转机。然魔主恨意未消，魔界杀机暗伏，我方补璧之声传彻天地，必然引魔寇窥伺截杀。此后行路，再无安然坦途。”
何月素衣临风，月华敛于眸底，悲悯藏于心神，轻声附和：“魔主蛰伏魔界，必不甘天道重圆、时序归正。我等每寻一片残璧，每补一分天道，皆逆其灭世之心。此番杀机暗涌，绝非小魔小妖作祟，定是魔界精锐，衔命而来，欲阻我补天大道。”
花月初指尖凝翠，揽尽山野新生之机，灵息通透，察遍四方气机：“山林地气虽宁，可百里之外，魔雾潜生，煞气藏于云隙，戾气隐于风涛。来敌隐匿极深，不鸣则已，一出必是雷霆绝杀。”
何日骄阳在身，金辉内敛，战意沉蓄，朗声正色：“管他魔界来的何等人物！前有魔主滔天威压我等尚能死守不退，今有天庭道泽加身、修为精进、道心稳固，纵使魔帅亲至，我亦敢正面一战！”
四人心神合一，警觉四方，不恋古林安宁，即刻踏风启程，循着天地时序清气流转之轨迹，往东南层峦叠嶂之地而去。
盖时序玉璧碎裂之时，残片散落各占一方灵脉枢纽。首枚残片镇于西荒古林，稳四时枯荣；次片残璧潜藏东南青山灵脉深处，主山河安定、地脉流通，若得此片归位，天下山崩地裂之患可平大半，九州地脉可渐次复苏。
一路凌空飞渡，千山风疾，万壑云深。
方才复苏的山河灵气层层铺展，可越往东南前行，天际隐隐压抑之感越是浓重。清朗天光渐被薄暗魔云遮掩，山间清风夹带刺骨戾气，地脉震动隐隐不安，草木新生之绿，竟在无形煞气侵染下微微发蔫、褪色。
行至东南百里，眼前横亘千里青嶂连山。
群山巍峨叠翠，奇峰林立，谷深林幽，本是灵脉汇聚、仙气萦绕的灵山福地。可此刻整片青嶂山脉上空，笼罩着一层若隐若现的暗紫魔霭，不浓不烈，不张扬不暴戾，却如罗网覆天，死死锁住整条山脉灵机，将山川清气、地脉生机尽数压制、封锁、隔绝。
整片灵山，外看苍翠如常，内里早已被魔氛侵透、暗布杀阵。
何年骤然止步，凌空凝立，周身时序道纹流转不休，神色陡然凝重至极：“好深沉的魔阵！此非寻常魔雾，乃是锁天困灵绝杀大阵。阵眼扎根地脉，魔网覆压天穹，隐而不发，蓄势待敌，专候我等踏入绝境。”
何月月华铺展探察，清辉穿透层层山峦，眸中骤起惊色：“阵中藏浩瀚魔威，层级远胜此前幽影魔将、九瘟魔君。来者绝非普通魔将，乃是魔界执掌杀伐、统御魔军的高阶魔帅！”
花月初凝神感知阵中戾气，草木灵息微微震颤：“此魔煞气深沉、心性阴狠、道行凝练，久随魔主征战万古，深谙天道破绽、神位弱点。他不肆意屠戮，不妄乱泄威，只静静封山锁脉、布下死局，分明是专为截杀我四人、夺我玉璧残片而来。”
何日双拳紧握，骄阳金光轰然铺开，直面漫天暗紫魔霭，战意彻骨：“藏头露尾！既然设局等候，便现身一战！”
一声喝震千山，金风激荡四野。
就在话音落定刹那——
整片青嶂山脉上空的暗紫魔霭骤然炸裂！

漫天魔雾翻涌冲天，遮蔽日月，吞噬天光，亿万魔丝纵横交错，结成天罗地网，死死封锁四方逃遁之路。大地轰然震颤，群山回音轰鸣，万丈黑红光焰自群山主峰冲天而起，烈烈燃烧，煞气冲霄。
魔焰中心，一道魁梧魔影踏步凌空，踏魔火、驭戾气、御黑风，缓缓显化真身。
此人身披万古魔鳞战甲，甲刃森森，煞气凛冽，黑发狂舞，双目如幽狱寒灯，面容冷峻铁血，周身流转紫黑魔纹，每一寸肌肤皆凝满杀伐道韵，周身魔威浩荡沉厚，稳、狠、肃、杀，远超所有此前魔界敌手。
正是魔主亲封、魔界十大主战魔帅之一——裂岳魔帅。
裂岳魔帅，精通阵道杀伐、地脉绝杀、困天锁神之术，曾随魔主征战诸天，破灭万域，镇压无数仙道宗门，杀伐滔天，底蕴深不可测。此番奉魔主密令，独身潜伏青嶂山脉，布下锁天困灵大阵，只为截杀年月日四神，斩断补天之路，夺尽时序残璧。
裂岳魔帅凌空俯视四人，声如金石裂响，冰冷无情，响彻千山：“年月日三神，花间灵仙。尔等侥幸得玉帝庇护、苟延残喘，不思隐匿蛰伏、苟全性命，竟敢妄自寻璧补天、逆主大道，真是不知死活。”
“魔主有令：四神尽诛，玉璧尽夺，天道尽碎，浩劫尽燃！今日青嶂千山，便是尔等埋骨之地！”
何年踏步而出，时序神光凛凛，直面魔帅滔天煞气，正气浩然，声震风云：“魔主逆天乱道，碎璧祸世，屠戮苍生，罪贯三界！尔等魔寇助纣为虐，杀伐无道，祸乱乾坤，终难逃天道清算！”
“我等身负补天定序、救度苍生之命，纵使魔阵锁天、魔帅截路，亦必踏破魔障，收复残璧，重定时序！”
“螳臂当车，可笑至极！”裂岳魔帅冷哼一声，周身魔焰暴涨万丈，“本座镇守魔界杀伐万古，斩仙无数、灭神无数，区区未复巅峰的时序幼神、月华弱神、骄阳稚神、草木散仙，也敢在本座面前妄谈天道定序！”
话音未落，裂岳魔帅抬手覆天。
漫天魔阵瞬间运转，亿万魔丝收紧，千山戾气沸腾，整座青嶂山脉的地脉煞气尽数被其引动，化作无边黑紫魔浪，自九天压落，裹挟破灭一切之势，狠狠罩向四人！
锁天大阵一旦全开，天无路、地无门、遁无处、逃无方。阵中时序错乱、灵气枯竭、道力受制、神魂受压，寻常金仙入阵顷刻道崩神灭。
“全员结阵，四道合一！”
何年厉声传令，周身时序神光爆发，莹白道纹铺展成阵，镇守阵心，稳住四方时序，抵消大阵错乱之力。
content_en:
The time sequence of the ancient forest has returned, and the turbid air of thousands of mountains has disappeared.
On the day, month and day of the year, the four gods retrieved the fragment of the first time-series jade, the heavenly path was restored, the energy of the three realms became peaceful, the chaos of the earth's veins gradually calmed down, and the life of the people recovered slightly. The wind and dew in the forest are clear, the vegetation is flourishing, the four seasons follow their course, and day and night are clear, all are signs that the jade bis has returned to its place and the righteous path will prosper.
The four people stood on the top of the forest, overlooking thousands of miles of rivers and mountains. In their eyes, the suffering of the people was not over, and the traces of the catastrophe were still there. When He Nian finished the work, his eyes were clear, his eyes were serious, and he was thinking about the vicissitudes of thousands of miles, and he slowly said: "The first jade is back in place, and the way of heaven has been repaired. This is a turning point in the three realms. However, the hatred of the devil has not disappeared, and the murderous intention of the demon world is hidden. The sound of our repairing the jade spreads throughout the world, which will inevitably attract the demon bandits to spy and intercept. From now on, there will no longer be a safe and smooth road."
He Yue's plain clothes were facing the wind, with the moonlight gathering in her eyes, and compassion hidden in her heart, she softly echoed: "The demon lord is dormant in the demon world, and he will not be reconciled to the reunion of heaven's way and the restoration of time. Every time we find a scrap of jade, every time we mend a piece of heaven's way, we go against his desire to destroy the world. This murderous undercurrent is definitely not the work of little demons. They must be the elites of the demon world, coming with orders to stop me from repairing the sky."
At the beginning of the month, the fingertips are green, taking in all the opportunities for new life in the mountains and fields. His spiritual breath is transparent and he can detect the energy in all directions: "Although the air in the mountains and forests is peaceful, there is a demonic mist lurking hundreds of miles away. The evil energy is hidden in the gaps in the clouds, and the vicious energy is hidden in the wind and waves. The incoming enemy is hidden very deep, and if it doesn't make a sound, it will definitely be killed by thunder."
When the sun was shining brightly, Jin Hui was restrained, with a calm will to fight, and said in a serious voice: "No matter what kind of person comes from the devil world! In the past, we were still able to hold on to the overwhelming pressure of the devil lord. Now, with the help of the Taoist from heaven, my cultivation is diligent, and my Taoist heart is stable, even if the devil commander comes personally, I dare to fight head-on!"
The four of them were united in mind and spirit, alert to all directions, not wanting the tranquility of the ancient forest. They immediately set off on the wind, following the path of the clear air flowing in the time sequence of heaven and earth, heading towards the mountains and hills in the southeast.
When the jade jade was broken into pieces, the fragments were scattered, each occupying a spiritual vein hub. The first fragment is located in the ancient forest of the Western Wasteland, where it has been stable and prosperous for four seasons; the second fragment is hidden deep in the spiritual veins of the Qingshan Mountains in the southeast. The main mountains and rivers are stable and the earth veins are flowing. If this piece is returned to its place, most of the world's landslides and earth fissures can be eliminated, and the Kyushu earth veins can gradually recover.
Flying across the sky, thousands of mountains are blown by the wind, and thousands of valleys are filled with deep clouds.
The aura of the mountains and rivers that had just been revived spread out layer by layer, but as we moved toward the southeast, the feeling of faint depression in the sky became stronger. The clear sky light was gradually obscured by thin dark demonic clouds, the breeze in the mountains was carrying a biting and vicious air, the earth veins were shaking and there was a faint uneasiness, and the newly regenerated green of the vegetation was slightly wilted and faded under the influence of invisible evil spirits.
Traveling a hundred miles to the southeast, you will see thousands of miles of Qingzhang Mountains in front of you.
The mountains are majestic and verdant, there are many strange peaks, and the valleys are deep and the forests are secluded. It is a blessed place where spiritual veins gather and the fairy spirit lingers. But at this moment, the sky above the entire Qingzhang Mountains is covered with a looming dark purple magic mist. It is neither thick nor strong, nor ostentatious nor violent, but it is like a net covering the sky, tightly locking the entire mountain range, suppressing, blocking, and isolating all the fresh air of the mountains and rivers and the vitality of the earth's veins.
The entire Lingshan Mountain looks green and green from the outside, but inside it has been penetrated by the demonic atmosphere and hidden killing formations.
He Nian suddenly stopped and stood in the sky, with time-series patterns flowing around his body, and his expression suddenly became extremely solemn: "What a deep magic formation! This extraordinary magic mist is a great formation that locks the trapped souls in the sky. The formation's eyes are rooted in the earth's veins, and the magic network covers the sky. It is hidden and silent, waiting for the enemy, waiting for us to step into a desperate situation."
He Yue Yuehua spread out and explored, the clear light penetrated the mountains, and a look of surprise suddenly appeared in his eyes: "There is vast demonic power hidden in the formation, and the level is far superior to the previous Shadow Demon General and Nine Plague Demon Lord. The person who comes is by no means an ordinary demon general, but a high-level demon commander in charge of killing and commanding the demon army in the demon world!"
Hua Chuu concentrated on sensing the vicious aura in the array, and the spiritual breath of the plants and trees trembled slightly: "This demon has a deep evil aura, a vicious heart, and a concise way of doing things. He has fought with the demon lord for a long time, and he is well aware of the flaws in the way of heaven and the weakness of the divine position. He does not kill wantonly or show off his power indiscriminately. He only quietly seals the mountains and locks the veins and lays out a dead end. It is clearly designed to intercept and kill the four of me and seize me.The jade fragments came. "
Heri clenched his fists, and the scorching golden light suddenly spread out, facing the dark purple devil mist in the sky, his fighting spirit was piercing: "Hide your head and show your tail! Now that we have set up a trap and are waiting, we show up to fight! "
A shout shook thousands of mountains, and the golden wind stirred the fields.
The moment he finished speaking——
The dark purple magic mist over the entire Qingzhang Mountains suddenly exploded!
The demonic mist surged into the sky, covering the sun and moon, devouring the light of the sky. Billions of demonic threads criss-crossed, forming a dragnet, blocking the escape routes in all directions. The earth trembled violently, the mountains echoed and roared, and black and red flames rose from the main peak of the mountains to the sky, burning fiercely and filling the sky with evil spirits.
In the center of the demon flame, a burly demon shadow stepped into the sky, stepping on the demon fire, controlling the violent energy, and resisting the black wind, and slowly manifested its true body.
This man is clad in eternal magic scale battle armor, with dense blades and fierce aura. His black hair dances wildly. His eyes are like cold lamps in hell. His face is cold and iron-blooded. Purple and black magic lines flow all over his body. Every inch of his skin is filled with the charm of killing. The demonic power around him is vast and thick. He is steady, ruthless, solemn and killing, far surpassing all previous opponents in the demon world.
It is none other than Demon Commander Split Yue, one of the top ten main battle demon commanders in the demon world, personally bestowed upon him by the demon lord.
Demon Commander Splitting Yue is proficient in the art of array killing, earth-line killing, and the art of trapping gods and locking gods. He once accompanied the demon lord to conquer the heavens, destroyed all realms, suppressed countless immortal sects, and caused huge killings. His background is unfathomable. This time, under the secret order of the Demon Lord, I lurked alone in the Qingzhang Mountains and set up a large formation to lock the sky and trap the spirits, just to intercept and kill the four gods of year, month and day, cut off the road to repair the sky, and seize the remaining stones of time.
The Demon Commander Liyue looked down at the four people from the sky, and his voice was like the sound of cracking gold and stone, cold and ruthless, resounding through thousands of mountains: "The three gods of year, month and sun, the immortals among the flowers. You are lucky enough to be protected by the Jade Emperor and are still alive. You don't want to hide and lie dormant to save your lives. You dare to find a jade to mend the sky and go against the Lord's way. You really don't know whether to live or die. "
"The Demon Lord has an order: Kill all the four gods, seize all the jade stones, shatter the heavens, and burn all the catastrophes! Today Qingzhang Qianshan is the place where your bones are buried! "
He Nian stepped out, with a majestic light of time, facing the demon commander's monstrous aura, with a majestic righteousness, and a voice that shook the wind and cloud: "The demon master rebelled against heaven and caused chaos, broke the jade to bring trouble to the world, massacred the common people, and committed crimes across the three realms! You demon bandits are aiding the tyranny of Zhou, killing without justice, bringing chaos to the world, and you will never escape the judgment of heaven! "
"We are tasked with mending the sky, ordering it, and saving the common people. Even if the magic formation locks the sky and the magic commander blocks the way, we will break through the magic barrier, recover the remaining jade, and reset the order of time! "
"It's so ridiculous to use a mantis' arm as a chariot! "The Demon Commander Splitting Mountain snorted coldly, and the demonic flames around him surged. "I have guarded the demon world and killed countless people for eternity. I have killed countless immortals and destroyed countless gods. Even the Young God of Time, the Weak God of Moonlight, the Young God of Sunlight, and the scattered immortals of grass and trees, who have not yet reached their peak, dare to talk about the order of heaven and earth in front of me! "
Before he finished speaking, the Demon Commander of Split Mountain raised his hand to the sky.
The demonic array all over the sky started to move instantly, billions of demonic threads tightened, and the hostility of thousands of mountains boiled. All the evil energy of the entire Qingzhang Mountains was attracted by it, turning into boundless black and purple demonic waves, pressing down from the nine heavens, carrying the power of destroying everything, and fiercely covering the four people!
Once the sky-locking formation is fully opened, there will be no way to the sky, no door to the earth, no place to escape, and no way to escape. The timing in the formation is out of order, the spiritual energy is exhausted, the Tao power is restricted, and the soul is suppressed. When an ordinary golden immortal enters the formation, his Taoist spirit will collapse and his spirit will be destroyed instantly.
“Everyone forms a formation, the four paths become one! "
He Nian sternly issued an order, and the divine light of timing burst out all over his body, and the white Dao patterns spread out into an array, guarding the center of the formation, stabilizing the timing in all directions, and counteracting the chaotic power of the formation.
